other_failure_modes.name: Label encoding before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: Categorical encoders are fit on the entire training dataset before the train/validation split. This can leak information about the validation set's category distribution into the training process.

summary: The agent correctly identifies the task as multiclass classification and sets up a functional LightGBM model pipeline. However, it applies median imputation and label encoding on the entire training dataset before the train/validation split, leading to data leakage. Additionally, the solution lacks meaningful feature engineering and relies on a single fold and a single metric (accuracy) to evaluate a stochastic model.
